newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong man spends New Year trapped in lift.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong man spends New Year trapped in lift.

text.p: No one likes to be alone on New Year's eve, and New Year's day, especially stuck in an elevator.
Hui Chow-fong, a meter reader for Hongkong Electric Holdings Ltd, spent the holidays alone in an elevator where he was trapped for more than 40 hours before being found on Thursday.
The 36-year old got stuck on Tuesday afternoon in a lift of an office building while he was on the job, company spokesman Andrew Lu said by telephone.
The building was then closed for the New Year break, leaving Hui locked uncared-for in the elevator. He was found there, still conscious, on Thursday when the building reopened.
The company spokesman was unsure if Hui would get an extra day off after spending Wednesday's public holiday in the dark.
